The four 2014- and 2015-built LR2 product tankers and three 2019-built suezmaxes were already on time charter to Trafigura, which will terminate as the vessels change hands during Q4 2026 and Q1 2027.

Strong demand for prompt availability of oil carriers has pushed the resale values of tankers higher; Clarksons data shows a 10-year-old Aframax, which is the same size as an LR2 tanker, was assessed to be worth $72.5M last week, while a 10-year-old Suezmax could sell for $110M.
